[center][font=Courier New][size=5]Hello! ◝(ᵔᗜᵔ)◜[/size][/font][size=1][font=Courier New]homies[/font]
[/size][font=Courier New][size=5]
[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]
[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]Made some new portraits and sprites for HARVEY! [/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]I chose Tony Tony Chopper as inspiration just because I thought it would be lore friendly and match Harvey's personality and charm!!![/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]
[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]Couldn't decide on backpack or no backpack so I did both! the portraits with the backpack is his winter outfit![/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]
[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]
HOW TO USE:
[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]
[/size][/font][color=#ff0000][font=Courier New][size=5]PLEASE DOWNLOAD AT YOUR OWN RISK:
THESE ARE XNBS SO THEY CHANGE THE ORIGINAL GAME FILES!!!
[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]TO BE SAFE MAKE SURE YOU MAKE A COPY OF YOUR SAVE FILES AS WELL AS THE ORIGINAL XNBS FOR HARVEY THAT WILL BE REPLACED AND PUT THEM ASIDE IN A FOLDER IN CASE YOU EVER NEED TO UNDO![/size][/font][/color][font=Courier New][size=5]
[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]

[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]
[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]IT SHOULD BE LOCATED IN:[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]
[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]
[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]C:\Program Files\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content [/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]
[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]
[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]ON MAC:[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]
[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]
[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5] FOR PORTRAITS[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]
[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]
[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]﻿/Users/-yournamehere-/Library/Application Support/Steam/steamapps/common/Stardew Valley/Contents/Resources/Content/Portraits[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]
[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]
[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]FOR SPRITES[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]
[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]
[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]﻿/Users/-yournamehere-/Library/Application Support/Steam/steamapps/common/Stardew Valley/Contents/Resources/Content/Characters[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]
[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]
[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]
[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]
[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]IF YOU STILL CANT FIND IT KEEP GOING TO THE ENCOMPASSING FOLDER/ENCLOSING FOLDER THROUGH THE MODS FOLDER UNTIL YOU SEE CONTENT OR CHARACTERS[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]
[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]
[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]
[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]
[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]LOCATE THE HARVEY.XNB FILES WITHIN EACH FOLDER[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]
[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]
[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]Characters > Harvey.xnb[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]
[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]
[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]Portraits > Harvey.xnb[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]
[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]
[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]DO NOT DELETE ORIGINAL GAME FILE XNB![/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]
[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]
[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]﻿2. DOWNLOAD MOD AND OPEN FOLDER[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]
[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]
[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]﻿You will see 2 folders:[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]
[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]
[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5][CHOPPER PORTAITS][/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5][CHOPPER SPRITES][/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]
[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]
[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]
[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]

[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]INSIDE WILL BE 3 XNBS [/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]
[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5][HARVEY.XNB][/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5][HARVEY_WINTER.XNB][/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5][HARVEY_BEACH.XNB][/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]
[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]
[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]DRAG ALL 3 over to the original game file folder located in[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]
[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]
[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]﻿Content> Portraits > Harvey.xnb[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]
[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]
[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]DROP new 3 XNBS into folder let it replace the 3 original Harvey XNBS (it will ask for confirmation to replace click yes)[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]
[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]
[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]DO NOT DELETE ORIGINAL GAME FILE XNB! LET IT REPLACE THE FILE![/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]
[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]
[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]TO BE SAFE YOU MAY COPY THE ORIGINAL Harvey.xnb FILE AND PLACE IT SOMEWHERE ELSE JUST IN CASE YOU WANT TO EVER GO BACK TO VANILLA Harvey[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]
[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]
[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]

[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]

[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]
[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]DRAG AND DROP new 3 XNBS into folder let it replace the 3 original Harvey XNBS (it will ask for confirmation to replace click yes)[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]

[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]over to the original game file folder located in[/size][/font][font=Courier New][size=5]
